buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Neither player has a fatigue edge. Workloads are close, 90 games for Monnet against 84 for Erjavec over 14 days, and neither shows a rest or rhythm problem. They last played 1 and 1 days ago respectively.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Monnet gets a slim nod on motivation and pressure. Monnet is on the way up (+90 Elo over 90 days) while Erjavec has been sliding (-23). Monnet's last 10 run 13 pts above the season win rate, while Erjavec is 6 pts below it. Offsetting that, when it goes the distance, Erjavec has won 47% of deciding sets over the past year to Monnet's 39%.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: A slight edge to Monnet on conditions. Monnet has 17 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Erjavec only 8, so the adjustment period is shorter.
